actions.name: raposa.request_investigation
actions.says: Ask Raposa to find a creative's dark funnel (and, when given, one of its ads'): deep or quick. Asking again while one waits or runs returns that one.

args.name: mode
args.says: deep: the whole ladder of disguises, then a sample; quick: only the rungs that cost nothing, the landing page's HTML only

args.name: ad_id
args.says: Tracks' id of one ad of the creative, when one matters

actions.costs: A deep one makes about 100 visits through the proxy lines; a quick one costs nothing.

actions.name: raposa.stop_investigation
actions.says: Stop an investigation. One that has not started stops at once; a running one stops at its next visit and keeps what it found.
actions.returns: true when it was stopped, false when it had already ended

actions.name: raposa.investigations
actions.says: Investigations and where each stands: waiting, running, completed, failed or stopped, the rung that saw the dark page, and whether the ad is cloaked.

actions.name: raposa.evidence
actions.says: The landing pages investigations reached, as proof of who runs an ad: domain, page kind, title, checkout and seller.
